package.name: star_supervisor
package.description:
Command gate + autonomy / e-stop arbiter for the STAR robot.
Arbitrates between manual teleop (/cmd_vel), Nav2 autonomous (/nav2/cmd_vel), and an e-stop (/star/estop), emitting a single /cmd_vel_out that the motor bridge consumes. Also forwards /goal_pose clicks into /nav2/goal_pose only while autonomy is enabled, so a Foxglove/Lichtblick "Goal" click does nothing when the operator has not armed autonomy.
The motor bridge independently subscribes to /star/estop as a second layer of safety -- do not rely on this node alone.
